rationale: Strict FP64 energy with three panels may group adjacent swapped W seeds using their original prepared pedantic descriptors. The shared backend owns pointer publication/vendor dispatch; every semantic product, summand, finite value and canonical energy address remains. A 48-byte stream-exclusive table is admitted after the original panel/provider choices; insufficient budget or typed preparation OOM keeps ordinary dispatch without reducing panel capacity. Generated/mixed providers, CuMetal, nonadjacent outputs and force/response retain the original route. No public option or ABI change.
revisit_condition: Broaden provider/precision/output domains only with independent numerical and complete endpoint evidence. Preserve pre-enqueue alias/scratch/counter refusal, sticky finite checks, six-entry fallback groups and no execution-time retry; a driver dispatch is not a semantic product or a vendor-internal kernel count.
